meta.name: pr-to-video
meta.description: Turn a GitHub pull request (a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a checked-out repo) into a code-change explainer video — changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough built from the diff, commits, and files: the input is a code change, not a website. Not a product promo (/product-launch-video) or a no-PR topic explainer (/faceless-explainer). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把一段代码改动的来龙去脉讲成一支视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要向团队说明某次代码改动到底做了什么。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a code change into an explainer video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to explain a code change to your team.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会读取一个 GitHub PR 的 diff、commit 和文件,产出分镜与脚本,再逐帧生成 HTML 画布,最终渲染成一段讲解这次代码改动的视频文件 renders/video.mp4。
howto.when: 当你给出 PR 链接、owner/repo#N,或在已检出的仓库里说「这个 PR」时接管,先抓取该 PR 再规划视频。意图不明时会转给 /hyperframes。

say.text: 把这个 PR 做成改动讲解视频:owner/repo#1842
say.note: 先抓取该 PR 的事实,再进入分镜规划

say.text: 在这个已检出的仓库里,把「这个 PR」做成 feature reveal 视频
say.note: 仓库里需要已有这个 PR

say.text: 讲解视频的旁白用指定音色(传入 --voice)
say.note: 不传就用管道默认音色

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude reads a GitHub PR's diff, commits and files, produces a storyboard and script, builds each frame as HTML, and renders an explainer video of that code change to renders/video.mp4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you give a PR URL, an owner/repo#N ref, or say "this PR" in a checked-out repo; it fetches the PR first, then plans the video. Unclear intent goes to /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Turn this PR into a code-change explainer video: owner/repo#1842
say_en.note: Fetches the PR facts first, then plans the storyboard

say_en.text: In this checked-out repo, make "this PR" into a feature-reveal video
say_en.note: The repo must already contain that PR

say_en.text: Use a specific voice for the narration (pass --voice)
say_en.note: Otherwise the pipeline default voice is used
